objective: Recover primary or near-primary documentation that fixes the identity, inscription, chronology and acquisition route of the Egyptian dagger publicly associated with the Museo Oro del Peru y Armas del Mundo in Lima.

primary_source_requests.target: Museo Oro del Peru y Armas del Mundo, Lima
primary_source_requests.purpose: Inventory/accession identity, exact cartouche transcription, acquisition provenance, dimensions, high-resolution recto/verso/cartouche images and confirmation that the website photograph depicts the museum's physical holding.

Fast in-hand check of their offered 1956 copy for Egypt/dagger/Tutmosis/cartouche material and a few phone photos if relevant.

1956_decision_rule.if_present: Anchor the dagger, or a sufficiently diagnostic predecessor, in Miguel Mujica Gallo's arms collection no later than 1956; then backtrace acquisitions before that date.
1956_decision_rule.if_absent: Do not infer post-1956 acquisition automatically. First measure catalogue coverage/completeness; if sufficiently comprehensive, prioritize 1956-1966 and later auction/travel/acquisition records.
1956_decision_rule.important_firewall: ABSENCE_FROM_CATALOGUE != ABSENCE_FROM_COLLECTION unless catalogue coverage is demonstrated.

epigraphy_rule: Do not turn a cartouche into a narrative sentence. Lock individual signs from high-resolution imagery first, then transliterate, then assign royal-name family, then test king attribution.
provenance_rule: COLLECTION_LABEL != ACCESSION_PASSPORT; WEBSITE_PHOTO != PHYSICAL_CUSTODY; MORPHOLOGICAL_MATCH != OBJECT_IDENTITY.
osiris_firewall: No promotion into the Mendes/Osiris mainline unless a source-bound dealer, accession, export, excavation, JE/CG/TR, Mendes/Djedet, Quibell, Nesbanebdjedet or related custody node intersects the established CROFT chain.
canonical_seal: GET THE PAGE. GET THE PASSPORT. GET THE CARTOUCHE. THEN RECONSTRUCT THE HANDOFF.
